core_obligations: Finiteness (proof lines 9876-9888): the author uses the Artin-Schreier sequence and the finiteness of the coherent cohomology of a proper scheme to obtain finiteness of the cohomology with coefficients Z/p in each degree.

Invariance (proof lines 9888-9899): the same description shows that extension of algebraically closed fields does not change the cohomology groups, because the Frobenius action and the differential forms involved are defined over the prime field.
proof_roadmap: Use the Artin-Schreier sequence to describe mod p cohomology in terms of coherent cohomology and differential forms.
Read finiteness off the coherent cohomology of a proper scheme.
Observe that the description is unchanged under extension of algebraically closed fields.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a proper scheme over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p the mod p etale cohomology is finite in each degree and unchanged under extension of algebraically closed fields (statement lines 9862-9874). The proof uses the Artin-Schreier sequence and the finiteness of coherent cohomology to obtain finiteness (proof lines 9876-9888) and then reads off the invariance from the explicit description of the cohomology in terms of forms defined over the prime field (proof lines 9888-9899). The non-formal content is the use of the Artin-Schreier description in both parts. The claim is H2: one description plus two consequences.
